Security company strikes suspected quad bike syndicate

Two suspected syndicate members were arrested on Wednesday, 30 September, while allegedly stripping a stolen quad bike in an open field in the suburb.

A private security company said its officers tracked the vehicle after it was reported stolen, and that a police vehicle crime unit was called to the scene.

The company said the group is believed to be linked to a string of similar thefts in the area over recent months.

Well done to the team, these syndicates have been terrorising the area for months now.
